(* ============================================================================================= *)

(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & SIL-3 EMERGENCY TRIP                     *)

(* Active-low fail-safe emergency trip circuit check *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: HP Cryo-Expander Inlet Pressure Transmitters 2oo3 Voting                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB) THEN
        IF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB;
        ELSIF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA;
        ELSIF (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB >= rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Monitor inter-channel deviation thresholds *)
    IF (ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA - rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB - rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA - rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar) THEN
        rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy := rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            (* Identify rogue transmitter and isolate *)
            IF ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA - rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB - rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_Inlet_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_P_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_P_Inlet_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 fail-operational mode *)
    rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA + rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA + rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC) THEN
    rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB + rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Degraded 1oo1 fallback mode *)
    IF bHealth_P_ChA THEN
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChB THEN
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_P_ChC THEN
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := rP_Inlet_Bar_ChC;
    ELSE
        (* Total instrument loss: trip *)
        rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar := 1.013;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: HP Cryo-Expander Inlet Temperature Sensors 2oo3 Voting                       *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC THEN
    IF (rT_Inlet_K_ChA >= rT_Inlet_K_ChB) THEN
        IF (rT_Inlet_K_ChB >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChB;
        ELSIF (rT_Inlet_K_ChA >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rT_Inlet_K_ChA >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChA;
        ELSIF (rT_Inlet_K_ChB >= rT_Inlet_K_ChC) THEN
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChC;
        ELSE
            rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChA - rT_Inlet_K_ChB) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChB - rT_Inlet_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K) OR
       (ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChA - rT_Inlet_K_ChC) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K) THEN
        rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy := rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChA - rT_Inlet_Voted_K) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rT_Inlet_K_ChB - rT_Inlet_Voted_K) > rTOL_T_Inlet_K THEN
                bHealth_T_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_T_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_T_Inlet_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChB) THEN
    rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Inlet_K_ChA + rT_Inlet_K_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChA AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Inlet_K_ChA + rT_Inlet_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_T_ChB AND bHealth_T_ChC) THEN
    rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 0.5 * (rT_Inlet_K_ChB + rT_Inlet_K_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_T_ChA THEN
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChB THEN
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_T_ChC THEN
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := rT_Inlet_K_ChC;
    ELSE
        rT_Inlet_Voted_K := 293.15;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: Expander Rotor Speed Proximity Pickups 2oo3 Voting                          *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bHealth_N_ChA AND bHealth_N_ChB AND bHealth_N_ChC THEN
    IF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB) THEN
        IF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB;
        ELSIF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA;
        ELSIF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB >= rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) THEN
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC;
        ELSE
            rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm) OR
       (ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm) OR
       (ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm) THEN
        rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy := rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm THEN
                bHealth_N_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB - rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm) > rTOL_N_Speed_Rpm THEN
                bHealth_N_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_N_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Speed_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_N_ChA AND bHealth_N_ChB) THEN
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.5 * (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA + rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_N_ChA AND bHealth_N_ChC) THEN
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.5 * (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChA + rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_N_ChB AND bHealth_N_ChC) THEN
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.5 * (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChB + rN_ExpanderSpeed_Rpm_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm := 0.0;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Digital Smoothing Filters *)
rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar := (rFilterWeight * rP_Inlet_Voted_Bar) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar);
rT_Inlet_Filt_K   := (rFilterWeight * rT_Inlet_Voted_K)   + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rT_Inlet_Filt_K);
rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm := (rFilterWeight * rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm);
rM_CryoAir_Filt_KgSec := (rFilterWeight * rM_CryoAirFlow_KgSec) + ((1.0 - rFilterWeight) * rM_CryoAir_Filt_KgSec);

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: MULTI-COMPONENT SLUSH SOLIDIFICATION BOUNDARY & RISK INDEX ESTIMATION             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Compute high-pressure solid-liquid coexistence boundary:                                     *)
(* T_freeze(P) = T_triple + dT/dP * (P - P_triple)                                              *)
rEvalFreezingT_K := rSolidificationBaseTemp_K + (rSlapinskiSlope_dPdT * (rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar - rP_TripleRef_Bar));

(* CO2 Henry's Law Solubility & Precipitation Offset *)
IF rCO2_Concentration_Ppm > rCO2_SolubilityLimit_Ppm THEN
    rEvalFreezingT_K := rEvalFreezingT_K + (0.028 * SQRT(rCO2_Concentration_Ppm - rCO2_SolubilityLimit_Ppm));
END_IF;

(* Atmospheric moisture ice crystal offset *)
IF rH2O_DewPoint_K > rH2O_FrostPointLimit_K THEN
    rEvalFreezingT_K := rEvalFreezingT_K + (0.018 * (rH2O_DewPoint_K - rH2O_FrostPointLimit_K));
END_IF;

(* Calculate instantaneous margin to phase transition [K] *)
rMarginToSolidification_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K - rEvalFreezingT_K;

(* Continuous Slush Formation Probability Index (0.0 = Safe, 1.0 = Active Ice Formation) *)
IF rMarginToSolidification_K <= 0.0 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 1.0; (* Deep freeze: solid crystals in nozzle throat *)
ELSIF rMarginToSolidification_K < 2.5 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.80 + (0.20 * (2.5 - rMarginToSolidification_K) / 2.5);
ELSIF rMarginToSolidification_K < 6.0 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.30 + (0.50 * (6.0 - rMarginToSolidification_K) / 3.5);
ELSIF rMarginToSolidification_K < 12.0 THEN
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.02 + (0.28 * (12.0 - rMarginToSolidification_K) / 6.0);
ELSE
    rSlushSolidificationRisk := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Slush Prevention Autonomous Trigger Flag *)
IF (rSlushSolidificationRisk >= 0.35) OR (rMarginToSolidification_K <= 4.5) THEN
    bAntiSlushMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bAntiSlushMitigationActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: THERMODYNAMIC ISENTROPIC EFFICIENCY & EXERGY POWER HARVESTING                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Isentropic temperature drop across Stage 1:                                                   *)
(* Delta_T_ideal = T_in * [1 - (P_inter / P_in)^((gamma - 1) / gamma)]                           *)
IF (rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar > 2.5) AND (rP_Interstage_Bar > 0.8) AND (rT_Inlet_Filt_K > 65.0) THEN
    rIdealTempDrop_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K * (1.0 - EXPT((rP_Interstage_Bar / rP_Inlet_Filt_Bar), ((rSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma - 1.0) / rSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma)));
    rActualTempDrop_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K - rT_Interstage_K;
    IF rIdealTempDrop_K > 0.15 THEN
        rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := (rActualTempDrop_K / rIdealTempDrop_K) * 100.0;
        IF rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct > 96.5 THEN
            rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 96.5;
        ELSIF rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct < 0.0 THEN
            rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Shaft Mechanical to Electrical Power Conversion: P_elec = eta_gen * tau * omega *)
rElectricalPower_Actual_kW := (rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm * (rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm * 0.104719755)) / 1000.0;

(* Cold Thermal Exergy Capture Rate into HGCS:                                                  *)
(* Ex_cold = m_htf * Cp_htf * [ (T_out - T_in) - T0 * ln(T_out / T_in) ]                        *)
IF (rT_ColdStoreHTF_In_K > 55.0) AND (rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K > 55.0) AND (rM_ColdStoreHTF_KgSec > 0.05) THEN
    rAccumulator := (rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K - rT_ColdStoreHTF_In_K) - (rT_DeadState_K * LN(rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K / rT_ColdStoreHTF_In_K));
    rColdExergyCaptured_kW := rM_ColdStoreHTF_KgSec * 2.18 * ABS(rAccumulator);
ELSE
    rColdExergyCaptured_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Format physical plant measurement deviation vector y_meas[4] *)
(* y[1] = delta T_inlet [K] (base 92.0 K) *)
(* y[2] = delta Omega [rad/s] (base 1884.95 rad/s) *)
(* y[3] = delta T_HTF [K] (base 85.0 K) *)
(* y[4] = Slush Precursor Nucleation [ppm] *)
rInnovation[1] := (rT_Inlet_Filt_K - 92.0) - xState_Pred[1];
rInnovation[2] := ((rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm * 0.104719755) - 1884.9556) - xState_Pred[2];
rInnovation[3] := (rT_ColdStoreHTF_Out_K - 85.0) - xState_Pred[3];
rInnovation[4] := (rSlushSolidificationRisk * 100.0) - xState_Pred[4];

(* State Estimation Correction Step: x_est = x_pred + L * innovation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := xState_Pred[iRow];
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := rAccumulator;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow]; (* Bind current active state *)
END_FOR;

(* Compute Disturbance Vector d *)
dDisturbance[1] := rM_CryoAir_Filt_KgSec - 15.0;
dDisturbance[2] := rCO2_Concentration_Ppm - 1.0;

(* Time Update / State Prediction for k+1: x_pred = A_d * x_est + B_d * u + E_d * d *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Pred[iRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF (iStateStep = 50) OR (iStateStep = 60) THEN
    (* Evaluate Slush Solidification Barrier Slack Constraint *)
    IF rMarginToSolidification_K < 5.0 THEN
        rSlushMarginSlack := 5.0 - rMarginToSolidification_K;
    ELSE
        rSlushMarginSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Iterative Optimization Loop *)
    FOR iQPIteration := 1 TO iMaxQPIterations DO
        (* Compute cost function gradient components: grad_J = B^T * Q * (C * x_pred) + R * u *)
        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 1: VIGV Position Command *)
        rGradJ[1] := (mB_d[1, 1] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 1] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 1] * vQ_Diag[3] * xState_Pred[3]) +
                     (mB_d[4, 1] * vQ_Diag[4] * (xState_Pred[4] + (rRhoSlushPenalty * rSlushMarginSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[1] * uControl[1]);

        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 2: Anti-Solidification Thermal Bypass Valve *)
        rGradJ[2] := (mB_d[1, 2] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 2] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 2] * vQ_Diag[3] * xState_Pred[3]) +
                     (mB_d[4, 2] * vQ_Diag[4] * (xState_Pred[4] - (2.5 * rRhoSlushPenalty * rSlushMarginSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[2] * uControl[2]);

        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 3: Inter-stage Thermal Reheat Heater *)
        rGradJ[3] := (mB_d[1, 3] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 3] * vQ_Diag[3] * xState_Pred[3]) +
                     (mB_d[5, 3] * 6.0 * xState_Pred[5]) +
                     (vR_Diag[3] * uControl[3]);

        (* Gradient w.r.t Actuator 4: Generator Electromagnetic Load Counter-Torque *)
        rGradJ[4] := (mB_d[2, 4] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (vR_Diag[4] * uControl[4]);

        (* Execute Projected Gradient Descent Step *)
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            uControl[iIdx] := uControl[iIdx] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[iIdx]);
        END_FOR;

        (* Hard Box Constraints Projection *)
        IF uControl[1] < -40.0 THEN uControl[1] := -40.0; ELSIF uControl[1] > 55.0 THEN uControl[1] := 55.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[2] <   0.0 THEN uControl[2] :=   0.0; ELSIF uControl[2] > 95.0 THEN uControl[2] := 95.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[3] < -60.0 THEN uControl[3] := -60.0; ELSIF uControl[3] > 380.0 THEN uControl[3] := 380.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[4] < -300.0 THEN uControl[4] := -300.0; ELSIF uControl[4] > 1600.0 THEN uControl[4] := 1600.0; END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: ISA-18.2 ALARM MATRIX & HARDWIRED TRIP SUPERVISION                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Trip 1: Rotor Overspeed Trip (122% of 18,000 rpm rated = 22,000 rpm) *)
IF rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm > 22000.0 THEN
    bTrip_OverSpeed_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 2: Slush Solidification Impingement (Margin <= 0.4 K) *)
IF rMarginToSolidification_K <= 0.4 THEN
    bTrip_SlushSevere_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 3: Magnetic/Foil Bearing Overheat (> 350 K) *)
IF rT_BearingMetal_DE_K > 350.0 THEN
    bTrip_BearingOverheat_Lat := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 4: Severe Rotor Shaft Radial Dynamic Vibration (> 32 um pk-pk) *)
IF (rVibration_DE_X_Um > 32.0) OR (rVibration_DE_Y_Um > 32.0) THEN
    bTrip_VibrationHigh_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 5: Loss of Cold-Box Vacuum Insulation (> 0.12 mbar) *)
IF rP_ColdBoxVacuum_Mbar > 0.12 THEN
    bTrip_VacuumLoss_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Trip 6: Loss of Dry Gas Seal N2 Barrier DP (< 0.70 bar) *)
IF (rP_DryGasSeal_Diff_Bar < 0.70) AND (iStateStep >= 40) THEN
    bTrip_SealGasLoss_Latched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Assemble Critical Latching Trip Bitmask *)
wTripAlarmBitmask.0 := bTrip_Hardwire_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.1 := bTrip_OverSpeed_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.2 := bTrip_SlushSevere_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.3 := bTrip_BearingOverheat_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.4 := bTrip_VibrationHigh_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.5 := bTrip_VacuumLoss_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.6 := bTrip_SealGasLoss_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.7 := NOT (bHealth_P_ChA OR bHealth_P_ChB OR bHealth_P_ChC);
wTripAlarmBitmask.8 := NOT (bHealth_T_ChA OR bHealth_T_ChB OR bHealth_T_ChC);
wTripAlarmBitmask.9 := NOT (bHealth_N_ChA OR bHealth_N_ChB OR bHealth_N_ChC);

(* Assemble Warning Advisory Bitmask *)
wWarningAlarmBitmask.0 := bAntiSlushMitigationActive;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.1 := bDegradedSensorMode;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.2 := (rVibration_DE_X_Um > 20.0) OR (rVibration_DE_Y_Um > 20.0);
wWarningAlarmBitmask.3 := rP_ColdBoxVacuum_Mbar > 0.04;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.4 := rP_DryGasSeal_Diff_Bar < 1.10;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.5 := rCO2_Concentration_Ppm > 3.80;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.6 := rH2O_DewPoint_K > 182.0;
wWarningAlarmBitmask.7 := rIsentropicEfficiency_Pct < 62.0;

(* Assemble 2oo3 Sensor Validation Bitmask *)
wSensorHealthBitmask.0 := bHealth_P_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.1 := bHealth_P_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.2 := bHealth_P_ChC;
wSensorHealthBitmask.3 := bHealth_T_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.4 := bHealth_T_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.5 := bHealth_T_ChC;
wSensorHealthBitmask.6 := bHealth_N_ChA;
wSensorHealthBitmask.7 := bHealth_N_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.8 := bHealth_N_ChC;

(* Trip Activation Enforcer *)
IF (wTripAlarmBitmask <> 16#0000) THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    IF (iStateStep <> 90) AND (iStateStep <> 99) THEN
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: DETERMINISTIC 10-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCE ENGINE                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
rCooldownRampRate_K_PerMin := ((rT_Inlet_Filt_K - rPreviousT_Inlet_K) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec) * 60.0;
rPreviousT_Inlet_K := rT_Inlet_Filt_K;

CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE_OFFLINE_STANDBY *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 0.0;
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND (NOT bEmergencyTripActive) AND (wTripAlarmBitmask = 16#0000) THEN
            IF iTargetOperatingMode = 1 THEN
                iStateStep := 10; (* Start Warm Purge *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            ELSIF (iTargetOperatingMode = 2) AND (rH2O_DewPoint_K < 185.0) THEN
                iStateStep := 20; (* Proceed to Prechill *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_DRY_GAS_PURGE_AND_INERTING *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 12.0;
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 25.0;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 45.0;
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 35.0;
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;

        (* Check for moisture dew point < 180 K (-93 deg C) and CO2 < 1.5 ppm *)
        IF (rH2O_DewPoint_K < 180.0) AND (rCO2_Concentration_Ppm < 1.5) AND (rStateTimer_Sec > 35.0) THEN
            IF iTargetOperatingMode >= 2 THEN
                iStateStep := 20;
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_Sec > 900.0 THEN
            (* Purge timeout *)
            iStateStep := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_CRYOGENIC_PRECHILL *)
        (* Maintain thermal ramp rate |dT/dt| <= 1.5 K/min to avoid casing distortion *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 4.0;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 12.0;
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;

        IF ABS(rCooldownRampRate_K_PerMin) > 1.35 THEN
            rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct + (12.0 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        ELSE
            rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct - (2.5 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        END_IF;
        IF rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct < 8.0 THEN rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 8.0; END_IF;
        IF rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct > 85.0 THEN rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 85.0; END_IF;

        IF (rT_Inlet_Filt_K <= 105.0) AND (rP_ColdBoxVacuum_Mbar < 0.025) THEN
            IF iTargetOperatingMode >= 3 THEN
                iStateStep := 30;
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_SEAL_AND_BEARING_STARTUP *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 35.0;
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;

        IF (rP_DryGasSeal_Diff_Bar >= 1.25) AND (rT_BearingMetal_DE_K < 315.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec > 6.0) THEN
            IF iTargetOperatingMode >= 3 THEN
                iStateStep := 40;
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_Sec > 180.0 THEN
            iStateStep := 90;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_TURBINE_RUNUP_SYNC *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;

        IF rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm < 17850.0 THEN
            rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct + (1.8 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
            rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 15.0;
        ELSIF (rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm >= 17850.0) AND (rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm <= 18150.0) THEN
            rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 19.5;
            IF (rStateTimer_Sec > 10.0) AND (iTargetOperatingMode = 4) THEN
                bExpanderRunning := TRUE;
                iStateStep := 50; (* Synchronized into Baseload MPC *)
                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct - (2.5 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        END_IF;
        IF rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct > 38.0 THEN rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 38.0; END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_BASELOAD_COLD_RECOVERY_MPC *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bExpanderRunning := TRUE;

        (* Closed-loop multivariable setpoints *)
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 48.0 + uControl[1];
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 10.0 + uControl[2];
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 140.0 + uControl[3];
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 920.0 + uControl[4];

        (* Power Demand Closed-Loop Integral Tracking *)
        IF rElectricalPower_Actual_kW < rPowerDemand_Setpoint_kW - 20.0 THEN
            rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct + (1.2 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        ELSIF rElectricalPower_Actual_kW > rPowerDemand_Setpoint_kW + 20.0 THEN
            rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct - (1.2 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        END_IF;

        IF bAntiSlushMitigationActive THEN
            iStateStep := 70;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF iTargetOperatingMode = 5 THEN
            iStateStep := 80;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_GRID_SUPPORT_FAST_TRANSIENT *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bExpanderRunning := TRUE;

        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 72.0 + uControl[1];
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 14.0 + uControl[2];
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 260.0 + uControl[3];
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 1550.0 + uControl[4];

        IF bAntiSlushMitigationActive THEN
            iStateStep := 70;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF iTargetOperatingMode = 4 THEN
            iStateStep := 50;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_ACTIVE_ANTI_SLUSH_DEICE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bExpanderRunning := TRUE;
        bAntiSlushMitigationActive := TRUE;

        (* 1. Force thermal bypass warm air injection proportional to deficit *)
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 50.0 + (50.0 * (1.0 - (rMarginToSolidification_K / 4.5)));
        IF rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct > 100.0 THEN rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 100.0; END_IF;

        (* 2. Throttle VIGV to decrease expansion ratio and raise throat static temp *)
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 20.0;

        (* 3. Maximize reheat heat duty *)
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 420.0;

        (* 4. Deload generator to prevent blade stalling under altered flow aerodynamics *)
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 400.0;

        IF (rMarginToSolidification_K >= 6.5) AND (rSlushSolidificationRisk < 0.08) AND (rStateTimer_Sec > 20.0) THEN
            bAntiSlushMitigationActive := FALSE;
            iStateStep := 50; (* Restored to normal MPC *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rMarginToSolidification_K <= 0.4 THEN
            bTrip_SlushSevere_Latched := TRUE;
            iStateStep := 90;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_RAMPDOWN *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;

        IF rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct > 2.0 THEN
            rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct - (4.0 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        ELSE
            rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        IF rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm > 40.0 THEN
            rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm - (120.0 * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        ELSE
            rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 20.0;
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 20.0;

        IF (rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct <= 0.1) AND (rN_Speed_Filt_Rpm < 450.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 0;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_TRIP_RAPID_ISOLATION_BLOWDOWN *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;

        (* Fast VIGV shutdown in < 150 ms *)
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;

        (* Pop open thermal bypass and vent bleed lines *)
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;

        (* Zero electric counter torque *)
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 0.0;

        IF (rN_ExpanderSpeed_Voted_Rpm < 40.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec > 12.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 99;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_LOCKOUT_TRIP_LATCH *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bExpanderRunning := FALSE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
        rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rBleedValve_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
        rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := 0.0;
        rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := 0.0;

        IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND (wTripAlarmBitmask = 16#0000) AND bEmergencyTrip THEN
            bEmergencyTripActive := FALSE;
            iStateStep := 0;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iStateStep := 90;
END_CASE;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 9: ACTUATOR OUTPUT LIMITS & FINAL SATURATION CLAMPING                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct < rVIGV_Min_Pct THEN
    rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := rVIGV_Min_Pct;
ELSIF rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct > rVIGV_Max_Pct THEN
    rVIGV_Position_Cmd_Pct := rVIGV_Max_Pct;
END_IF;

IF rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct < rBypass_Min_Pct THEN
    rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := rBypass_Min_Pct;
ELSIF rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct > rBypass_Max_Pct THEN
    rBypassValve_Cmd_Pct := rBypass_Max_Pct;
END_IF;

IF rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW < rHeater_Min_kW THEN
    rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := rHeater_Min_kW;
ELSIF rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW > rHeater_Max_kW THEN
    rInterstageHeater_Cmd_kW := rHeater_Max_kW;
END_IF;

IF rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm < rTorque_Min_Nm THEN
    rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := rTorque_Min_Nm;
ELSIF rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm > rTorque_Max_Nm THEN
    rGeneratorTorque_Cmd_Nm := rTorque_Max_Nm;
END_IF;

(* Format Status Word *)
wStatusBitmask.0 := bSystemReady;
wStatusBitmask.1 := bExpanderRunning;
wStatusBitmask.2 := bAntiSlushMitigationActive;
wStatusBitmask.3 := bEmergencyTripActive;
wStatusBitmask.4 := bDegradedSensorMode;
wStatusBitmask.5 := (iStateStep = 50);
wStatusBitmask.6 := (iStateStep = 60);
wStatusBitmask.7 := (iStateStep = 70);
wStatusBitmask.8 := (iStateStep = 90) OR (iStateStep = 99);

iCurrentState := iStateStep;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
